title: Candidate Intent
description: Structured output from the Haskell NLP parser — a candidate task intent extracted from a transcript segment.

id.description: UUID v7 for this candidate intent

parser_version.description: Version of dictask-parse that produced this intent

raw_text.description: The original transcript segment this intent was extracted from

confidence.description: Parser confidence score. >= 0.8 auto-apply, 0.3-0.8 review, < 0.3 log only

review_required.description: Whether this intent requires human review before application

parsed_data.description: Structured extraction from the raw text

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date, or null if no deadline mentioned

deadline_tentative.description: True if deadline is vague (e.g. 'after Easter', 'next week sometime')

target_task_id.description: For update/delete intents: which existing task this refers to

ambiguity_notes.description: Parser notes about why confidence is low or what was ambiguous
